comments.text:
My wife is from the Alki neighborhood. We lived just above the Fauntleroy ferry for 26 years, raised our kids there. 
For the last 18 years we’ve lived on the Olympic Peninsula in a small town. Wouldn’t live in King County anymore but we visit a couple times a year. 
Yes, we live in a lovely part of the country. Please come visit us, Adam.
